question_text: A 16-year-old boy presents to the emergency department after a skateboarding accident. He fell on a broken bottle and received a 4 cm wound on the dorsal aspect of his left hand. His vitals are stable and he was evaluated by the surgeon on call who determined to suture was not required. After several weeks the wound has almost completely healed (see image). Which of the following is the correct description of this patient’s wound before healing?
